# GENERATED BY rpxtool
# Source: rpxtool/mod_data/scripted_effects/behavioral/valiant.py

rpx_setup_valiant_defense = {
	rpx_calc_valiant_baseline = yes
	set_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_prev_surrender = surrender_progress }
	rpx_sync_valiant_defense = yes
}

rpx_sync_valiant_defense = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_bonus > 0 }
			NOT = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = rpx_valiant_defense }
			}
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = rpx_valiant_defense }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = rpx_valiant_def_bonus
				value = 0
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = rpx_valiant_defense }
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = rpx_valiant_defense }
	}
	else = {
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

rpx_update_valiant_defense = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_war = yes
			surrender_progress > 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = surrender_progress
					value = rpx_valiant_def_prev_surrender
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_bonus = 0.02 }
		}
		else = {
			rpx_calc_valiant_baseline = yes
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			var = rpx_valiant_def_bonus
			min = 0
			max = 0.30
		}
		set_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_prev_surrender = surrender_progress }
		rpx_sync_valiant_defense = yes
	}
	else = {
		rpx_calc_valiant_baseline = yes
		set_variable = { rpx_valiant_def_prev_surrender = 0 }
		rpx_sync_valiant_defense = yes
	}
}
